mapper.select: select r.record_id, r.customer_id, r.follow_type, r.content, r.follow_time, r.next_follow_time, r.visit_count, r.companion, r.reception_user_id, r.visit_purpose, r.feedback, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.remark, u.nick_name as create_by_name, ru.nick_name as reception_user_name from crm_follow_record r left join sys_user u on u.user_name = r.create_by left join sys_user ru on ru.user_id = r.reception_user_id where r.record_id = #{recordId}

select r.record_id, r.customer_id, r.follow_type, r.content, r.follow_time, r.next_follow_time, r.visit_count, r.companion, r.reception_user_id, r.visit_purpose, r.feedback, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.remark, u.nick_name as create_by_name, ru.nick_name as reception_user_name, case when r.follow_type = '3' then ( select count(*) from crm_follow_record r2 where r2.customer_id = r.customer_id and r2.follow_type = '3' and (r2.follow_time < r.follow_time or (r2.follow_time = r.follow_time and r2.record_id <= r.record_id)) ) else null end as visit_seq from crm_follow_record r left join sys_user u on u.user_name = r.create_by left join sys_user ru on ru.user_id = r.reception_user_id where r.customer_id = #{customerId} order by r.follow_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into crm_follow_record (customer_id, follow_type, content, follow_time, next_follow_time, visit_count, companion, reception_user_id, visit_purpose, feedback, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{customerId}, #{followType}, #{content}, #{followTime}, #{nextFollowTime}, #{visitCount}, #{companion}, #{receptionUserId}, #{visitPurpose}, #{feedback}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
